faqItem1H: Can you explain GreWeCo in simple terms?
faqItem1p: GreWeCo is a blockchain-based platform that allows people to invest in real trees and reforestation projects while earning returns from carbon credits and timber sales.
faqItem2H: Are you selling real trees or just digital assets?
faqItem2p: GreWeCo sells real trees growing on physical land. Each tree is tokenized, meaning its ownership and profit rights are represented on the blockchain for transparency and security.
faqItem3H: What guarantees and protections do users have?
faqItem3p: We ensure transparency and security through blockchain technology. Your investment is backed by real assets, and our smart contracts ensure that your ownership and profit rights are protected.
faqItem4H: How can users verify the legitimacy of GreWeCo?
faqItem4p: All our assets and transactions are recorded on a decentralized blockchain, ensuring full transparency. You can verify tree ownership and project authenticity through smart contracts and public records
faqItem5H: How do investors make a profit with GreWeCo?
faqItem5p: Investors earn money through the sale of carbon credits, timber harvesting, and the appreciation of tokenized tree assets.
faqItem6p: GreWeCo makes revenue from carbon credit sales, timber sales, partnerships with businesses looking to offset emissions, and transaction fees on the platform.
faqItem7H: Why are tokenized assets a better investment than traditional methods?
faqItem7p: Tokenized assets offer increased liquidity, security, and transparency. Unlike traditional investments, blockchain-based assets allow fractional ownership and real-time tracking of value.
faqItem8H: Is GreWeCo a good investment if I have no blockchain knowledge?
faqItem8p: Absolutely! Our platform is designed to be user-friendly, so you don’t need technical expertise to invest in trees and earn returns.
faqItem9H: Why did GreWeCo choose Paulownia trees?
faqItem9p: Paulownia is one of the fastest-growing trees, making it an excellent option for sustainable timber production and carbon sequestration. It offers high yields while having a low environmental impact.
faqItem10H: Who is responsible for managing the trees and land?
faqItem10p: Our certified forestry partners handle tree planting, maintenance, and harvesting, ensuring compliance with environmental standards and sustainability best practices.
faqItem11H: Can I visit the land where my trees are growing?
faqItem11p: Yes, GreWeCo provides GPS coordinates and tracking data for each plot. Investors may also arrange visits to partner plantations.
faqItem12H: What happens if my trees get damaged or destroyed?
faqItem12p: We implement risk management strategies, including diversified plantations, insurance partnerships, and sustainable forestry practices to mitigate risks.
faqItem13H: How does GreWeCo use blockchain technology?
faqItem13p: We tokenize trees and carbon credits, ensuring transparent ownership, real-time tracking, and secure transactions through blockchain.
faqItem14H: Why is blockchain important for this project?
faqItem14p: Blockchain provides immutability, fraud prevention, and efficient digital ownership transfer, making the investment process transparent and secure.
faqItem15H: How do I track my investment?
faqItem15p: You can monitor your trees, earnings, and environmental impact in real time via our platform, which integrates blockchain records and satellite data.
faqItem16H: What happens to my NFT if I want to sell it?
faqItem16p: You can sell your NFT-backed tree ownership on our marketplace or other supported platforms, allowing you to exit the investment whenever you choose.
